gt01_forest_closed.speaker: narrator
gt01_forest_closed.text: An overgrown trail runs east into old forest.

gt01_forest_closed.speaker: reno
gt01_forest_closed.text: Later. The grove still needs us.

C5_01_trail.speaker: narrator
C5_01_trail.text: The old trail into Hutan Seribu Bunga. The flowers along it are drooping, grey at the edges, like they've forgotten what colour they were.

C5_01_trail.speaker: elias
C5_01_trail.text: No radio signal at all out here. Just bees. Very organised bees.

C5_01_trail.speaker: narrator
C5_01_trail.text: Up ahead, someone is calling from inside a knot of dead vines.

C5_01_trail.speaker: maris
C5_01_trail.text: Hello? Is someone there? I'm a bit... stuck.

C5_01_trail.speaker: narrator
C5_01_trail.text: New goal: help whoever is stuck in the vines.

maris_tangled.speaker: maris
maris_tangled.text: The vines went dead around me in the night. They're too tough for me to pull. Is there a root spirit with you?

C5_02_free_maris.speaker: narrator
C5_02_free_maris.text: Reno digs his heels in and pulls. Root Grip! The dead vines crack and fall apart.

C5_02_free_maris.speaker: narrator
C5_02_free_maris.text: A spirit in leaf-green tumbles out, flowers tangled in her hair.

C5_02_free_maris.speaker: maris
C5_02_free_maris.text: Oh! Thank you. I'm Maris. I keep the sanctuary. Or I did, until it started forgetting how to grow.

C5_02_free_maris.speaker: lumi
C5_02_free_maris.text: We're following a man with ink on his fingers. He came here for a forgetting flower.

C5_02_free_maris.speaker: maris
C5_02_free_maris.text: Lupa-bloom. It grows nowhere but here, and we keep it small, very small, for a reason. He planted a whole pocketful at the Heart.

C5_02_free_maris.speaker: reno
C5_02_free_maris.text: Then let's go pull it up!

C5_02_free_maris.speaker: maris
C5_02_free_maris.text: Not so fast. The stream bridges have wilted. But I can Regrow them. Let me come.

C5_02_free_maris.speaker: narrator
C5_02_free_maris.text: Maris joined the party! In battle: Bloom Heal (heals everyone) and Thorn Lash. In the field: Regrow, at wilted vine bridges.

C5_02_free_maris.speaker: narrator
C5_02_free_maris.text: (Four in the party now: the first three fight. Change the order in Menu > Party.)

sb01_not_yet.speaker: lumi
sb01_not_yet.text: Someone's calling back there. We should help them first.

C5_03_flowers.speaker: narrator
C5_03_flowers.text: The Thousand Flowers: a valley of every colour, fading at the centre. Two streams cut across it.

C5_03_flowers.speaker: maris
C5_03_flowers.text: Three of the oldest blossoms remember things for the whole sanctuary. If Lumi listens, they'll show us what happened.

regrow_done.speaker: narrator
regrow_done.text: A healthy vine bridge, humming with bees.

regrow_1.speaker: narrator
regrow_1.text: A wilted vine, drooping over the stream where a bridge used to be.

regrow_1.speaker: maris
regrow_1.text: Come on, old friend. Remember how to reach.

regrow_1.speaker: narrator
regrow_1.text: Maris Regrows the vine. It stretches, thickens, and lies down across the water as a bridge.

regrow_2.speaker: narrator
regrow_2.text: A wilted vine, drooping over the stream where a bridge used to be.

regrow_2.speaker: maris
regrow_2.text: Come on, old friend. Remember how to reach.

regrow_2.speaker: narrator
regrow_2.text: Maris Regrows the vine. It stretches, thickens, and lies down across the water as a bridge.

blossom_look.speaker: narrator
blossom_look.text: A huge old blossom, its petals half-closed.

blossom_look.speaker: maris
blossom_look.text: Lumi should listen to this one.

blossom_done.speaker: narrator
blossom_done.text: The blossom is open now, and smells of rain.

memory_1.speaker: narrator
memory_1.text: Lumi touches the blossom. Memory Touch.

memory_1.speaker: narrator
memory_1.text: The memory is very old. Humans and spirits, side by side, planting the first flowers here together. A woman says: "We choose to share this. Nobody is made to."

memory_1.speaker: lumi
memory_1.text: The Great Promise wasn't a wall. It was a garden.

memory_2.speaker: narrator
memory_2.text: Lumi touches the blossom. Memory Touch.

memory_2.speaker: narrator
memory_2.text: A young spirit in an Oathkeeper's grey coat kneels in the flowers, crying. Smoke on the horizon, a railway signal bent double. "I couldn't hold the crossing. I couldn't hold it."

memory_2.speaker: lumi
memory_2.text: 1951... Something went very wrong at a crossing. He blamed himself.

memory_3.speaker: narrator
memory_3.text: Lumi touches the blossom. Memory Touch.

memory_3.speaker: narrator
memory_3.text: Last week. A tired man in a grey coat, ink on his fingers, kneels in the same spot. He plants seeds very carefully. "So nobody has to remember. So it never hurts like that again."

memory_3.speaker: lumi
memory_3.text: It's the same person. Older. He's still crying, he's just doing it quietly.

memories_check.speaker: maris
memories_check.text: That's all three. And now we know what's at the Heart.

sb02_heart_closed.speaker: maris
sb02_heart_closed.text: The Heart is just past here. But let's hear what the blossoms remember first. We should know what we're facing.

sb02_mixed_beaten.speaker: maris
sb02_mixed_beaten.text: Poor things. They're only like that because the Heart is sick.

bee_spirit.speaker: bee_spirit
bee_spirit.text: Bzz. Queen's orders: fix the Heart, please. Thank you. Bzz.

C5_05_bloom_intro.speaker: narrator
C5_05_bloom_intro.text: At the Heart, a flower the size of a house sways over the grass. Its petals are every colour and no colour.

C5_05_bloom_intro.speaker: forgetting_bloom
C5_05_bloom_intro.text: Shh. Lie down. Forget the trains. Forget the river. Forget your names. It doesn't hurt if you forget.

C5_05_bloom_intro.speaker: maris
C5_05_bloom_intro.text: Everyone stay near me. I'll keep you standing.

C5_05_bloom_outro.speaker: narrator
C5_05_bloom_outro.text: The Forgetting Bloom folds up, smaller, smaller, until it's a single little purple flower, the size it was always meant to be.

C5_05_bloom_outro.speaker: maris
C5_05_bloom_outro.text: There. Lupa-bloom should be small. A little forgetting helps you sleep. A lot of it... does that.

C5_05_bloom_outro.speaker: narrator
C5_05_bloom_outro.text: Got the Petal Brooch (Maris: MAG +2, RES +2).

C5_05_bloom_outro.speaker: narrator
C5_05_bloom_outro.text: Something is tangled in the roots: a ticket stub, ink on its edge.

C5_05_bloom_outro.speaker: elias
C5_05_bloom_outro.text: "Pasar Malam Impian. Admit one." The midnight carnival. It never stays in one place.

C5_06_breathing.speaker: narrator
C5_06_breathing.text: The Heart of the Sanctuary breathes out. Colour runs back into the flowers like water into a dry stream.

C5_06_breathing.speaker: maris
C5_06_breathing.text: He came here because he's hurting, and he thought forgetting would help. I'd like to tell him it doesn't. If we find him.

C5_06_breathing.speaker: reno
C5_06_breathing.text: A carnival! Do they have trains?

C5_06_breathing.speaker: elias
C5_06_breathing.text: They have a ghost train. I'm told it's terrible.
